records.name: Archie Foldwall
records.biography_en: Archie Foldwall works the Panel Detail with The Instant Front. When a player leaves another HyperNorm block in pieces, the crew returns with familiar tools and a fresh estimate. Archie Foldwall takes pride in leaving one small part of the district easier to live in.
records.frizzlebob_note_en: FrizzleBob: Archie Foldwall has seen this corner before. The building was facing another direction then.
